title: 'Paper Tiger': Scarlett Johansson and Adam Driver shine in Russian mob thriller
summary: This week on arts24, Emma Jones and Dheepthika Laurent discuss the latest film releases. We start with "Paper Tiger", a Russian mob thriller starring Adam Driver, Scarlett Johansson and Miles Teller. It is a return to familiar crime thriller territory for James Gray, the director behind "Little Odessa" and "The Yards".
